native.emptyBody: New activity will appear here. Pull down to refresh.
native.offline: Unable to reach the server. Your session is saved. Try again when connected.
native.permission: Allow camera or microphone access in Settings to continue.
native.pushPending: In-app notifications are available. Native push delivery awaits server APNs support.
native.nfcUnavailable: NFC is available on a supported physical iPhone. You can use QR or search by name.
native.nfcFailure: The card could not be completed. Keep the card still and try again. No success was reported to the server.
native.retryReport: Card written. Retry reporting to the server without writing again.
native.confirmName: Does the printed card show this name?
native.nfcPrompt: Hold the card near the top of your iPhone.
native.expired: Expired. Refresh to get a new code.
native.mediaTooLarge: This file is too large. Capture a smaller file and try again.
native.accessLost: Access to this conversation has ended.
native.hqWeb: Manage this in the HQ dashboard
native.captured: Screen recording hides this community. Screenshots are reported to the crew.
